# QQQ backtest summary

- Period: 2016-01-04 to 2026-11-20 (2738 trading sessions, split/dividend-adjusted)
- Strategy: invest 99% of cash in QQQ when SMA10 crosses above SMA50; sell to cash on the cross below
- Execution: decided on the close, filled at the next open (1 bp half-spread) plus 0.03% cost per side; open position closed at the final close
- Buy & hold: all capital into QQQ at the first close, sold at the last close (costs both sides)
